formal.basis: C-01 and C-03 exclude missing artifacts and empty numeric data from precision. Arm micro means pool measured fragments. Macro means weight each measured card equally. The original rule tests reference or query support; strict uses its own recorded counts. The sample diagnostic adds strict snapshot matches among originally unsupported fragments. Pairwise differences subtract the left arm from the right on tasks with both cards measurable. The interval resamples entire families and uses the task-weighted mean paired difference. Within-arm changes pair the same task at the first and final checkpoints. Only pairs with measured data at both checkpoints enter score and fragment-count changes.

interpretation: Each card contributes distinct numeric fragments in first-frame Text content. Historical source support uses bidirectional text matching. A secondary diagnostic requires normalized equality of whole fragments, with conservative spelling and unit-boundary checks. Additional strict matches in registered input samples are reported among historically unsupported fragments. These checks cannot establish correct entity, denominator, units or runtime data. A4a uses the same originals. Cards with no numeric fragment and missing outputs are counted separately.
